main_subject.description: An original adult woman with long honey-blonde loose waves, soft-glam makeup, and a confident relaxed expression.
main_subject.wardrobe: A fitted white ribbed sleeveless top with red shoulder straps and muted teal piping, paired with high-waisted light-wash denim jeans.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Waist-up three-quarter profile, turning her head back toward camera with one hand resting in her hair.

composition_elements.setting: A clean studio portrait set with an abstract red, white, and blue striped textile backdrop; stars and stripes are decorative shapes only, not a reproduction of a flag.
composition_elements.framing: Vertical medium portrait with the subject separated from the backdrop by a crisp cast shadow.
composition_elements.text_and_brand_control: No celebrity likeness, logos, badges, text, flag insignia, or identifiable branding.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: High-key direct on-camera flash creating a bold, defined shadow against the textile.

technical_specs.rendering: Sharp focus, natural skin texture, realistic anatomy, restrained film-like grain.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 4:5 vertical direct-flash editorial photograph of an original adult woman with long honey-blonde loose waves, soft-glam makeup, and a confident relaxed expression. She wears a fitted white ribbed sleeveless top with red shoulder straps and muted teal piping, with high-waisted light-wash denim jeans. Frame a waist-up three-quarter profile as she turns her head toward camera with one hand in her hair. Place her before a clean abstract red, white, and blue striped textile backdrop with decorative star shapes that do not reproduce a flag. Use high-key on-camera flash, a bold crisp cast shadow, sharp focus, natural skin texture, realistic anatomy, and restrained film grain. No celebrity likeness, logos, text, badges, flag insignia, or brand marks.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, named person, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, lingerie, fetish styling, flag reproduction, logos, badges, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, AI artifacts
